title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

faults.what: The output is approximately 1.67:1 rather than the specified 16:9; however, this matches the original image and correctly avoids cropping or changing its composition.

judge.summary: The image is cleanly converted to neutral black and white with the car and surroundings preserved, although its original aspect ratio is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car, street, foliage, houses, and sky all appear neutral grayscale.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The car's placement, outline, wheels, windows, lights, trim, and rear details remain unchanged.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: The houses, trees, parked cars, utility poles, pavement, and shadows retain their original arrangement and details.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in 16:9.
must_haves.why: The full original composition is retained without visible cropping, but both images are approximately 1.67:1 rather than 16:9.
